<cat>gameevent</cat>

	<description>
			Called when a Client becomes the Cameraman.
	</description>
	<fields>
		<item type="number" name="index">The <page text="EntIndex">Entity:EntIndex</page> of the new Cameraman.</item>

# Examples
<example>

	<code>

	-- Called when a Client becomes the Cameraman
	
end )
	</code>
